purpose: The durable methods for turning a FLAT, disjointness-free run ontology into an AUTHENTIC genus+differentia taxonomy that supports Data-Element ELUCIDATION. Captured as a component so the pipeline wires into Metaflow as a step when appropriate (RH 2026-07-14). The taxonomy mid-tier IS the differentia structure: a genus alone is a bag; what makes it a taxonomy is that each species earns a differentia. authentic-taxonomy ≡ sufficient-differentia ≡ elucidable-ontology.

problem_frame.objective: INSUFFICIENT DIFFERENTIA (per-element), not confusable-pairs (RH: pairwise is too limiting — intrinsic, open-world, and it IS the elucidation objective; differentia is only defined UNDER a genus, which is why the mid-tier is the precondition).
problem_frame.guard_observable_vs_logical: A differentia counts only if it is DATA-OBSERVABLE (projects to a column / FK), not a purely metaphysical distinction. Trichotomy: differentia in-shape → discriminable; in-OWL-not-shape → projection gap (SHACL arc); not-in-OWL → ontology gap (author one, or mark legitimately-non-observable).

calibration_constraint.rule: The taxonomy's breadth × depth is bounded by the distribution of probability mass relative to the discriminating potential among element specifications in the GENERATED lexicon — concretely the vector-space separability the NHSVM / Atelier discriminators can exploit (RH 2026-07-14).
calibration_constraint.mechanism: rate-distortion. The lexicon is a source; the taxonomy quantizes it into genus cells. Adding genera lowers distortion only while the source HAS the information; past the FRONTIER (inertia elbow / silhouette peak) we quantize NOISE = fabricated differentia below the discriminator's resolution. Induce AT the frontier, never finer; measure differentia-sufficiency RELATIVE to that resolution, not absolute.
calibration_constraint.future_versions: The frontier moves out only with more probability mass: (1) more lexicon/corpus (primary, free) → higher frontier_k + real species per genus; (2) stronger encoder/generator → higher intrinsic_dim; (3) NHSVM/discriminator must scale JOINTLY or finer labels are unusable; (4) domain concentration for depth. Always report differentia_sufficiency vs the current frontier and TRACK intrinsic_dim / frontier_k across versions.

1_genus_induction.method: embed element specs (name+definition+attrs, all-MiniLM-L6-v2) → measure discriminating potential (intrinsic_dim = eigenspectrum participation ratio; inertia-elbow / silhouette sweep → frontier_k) → KMeans at frontier_k → per-element differentia_sufficiency (margin to 2nd-nearest genus + near-duplicate-sibling detection). Provisional genera are a SCAFFOLD.

first_run.reading: 32 genera = breadth; sub-structure to 512 = depth; ~111-dim budget shared

2_differentia_authoring.method: AUTHENTICATE the scaffold via the Holland S&B CAS loop. name_genus() → a real superordinate (NOT a member). Then per species: BOUNDARY (insufficient) → SIGNAL (genus + species + confusable siblings) → AGENT proposes the single most salient OBSERVABLE differentia → MEMBRANE disposes → re-prompt on reject (closed loop, never one-shot).
2_differentia_authoring.proposer: SWAPPABLE. engine_proposer (single gRPC call to Qwen3.6 via aegir.engine.client, schema-constrained + re-prompt) now; an ACP-harnessed multi-turn proposer (aegir.refine.acp) drops in where the task needs tool-use, WITHOUT touching the loop or membranes.

membranes.parse: property camelCase, kind∈{data,object} (normalized), restriction present; rejects format-example echoes.
membranes.observability: data → needs xsd datatype / enumerated value; object → needs a Manchester restriction onto a target class; a value restriction must be a real value, not the property name.
membranes.discrimination: the differentia must not be identical to any accepted sibling's — the CAS re-prompt driver (a shared property with DIFFERENT values is fine; identical is rejected with the colliding sibling named).
membranes.hermit_TODO: batched: consistency + genus+differentia ⊨ species + non-triviality vs siblings (build_realized_ontology.consistency_check, AEGIR_REASON_BUDGET_S-guarded). Not yet wired — the next increment; also a stronger value-guard (value ≠ class name).

2_differentia_authoring.pilot: genus 'Record' (DatabaseRecord/AssessmentRecord/PatientRecord/HealthRecord/EmploymentRecord/ComplianceRecord/CertificationRecord) → 7/7 differentiated, ~1 round: PatientRecord→consentStatus value 'active', ComplianceRecord→issuingAuthority some RegulatoryAuthority, EmploymentRecord→employmentPeriod value 'work performed'.

pipeline.3_downstream_cascade: authored differentia → disjointness adjudication WITHIN real genera (#6 machinery) → SHACL arc carries the differentia into shapes (discriminative faithfulness; discriminability.projection_gap_rate→0) → re-project corpus (disambiguating columns) → DEE eval ground truth (Harbor/Terminal-Bench + Atropos RL).

metaflow_wiring: when appropriate: a foreach over induced genera → name_genus + author_genus (proposer=engine or ACP) → batched HermiT membrane → emit accepted axioms → re-measure differentia_sufficiency → accrete into the catalog. Idempotent per genus (cache by genus signature + prompt_version). Depth recurses within each genus, bounded by the local frontier.
